dateNote: The report (issue of Sept. 5, 2024) says only that the board 'recently approved' the raise and that it is 'already in effect'; it gives no meeting date or type. The OAgendas calendar begins Sept. 9, 2024. Listed here as August 2024; the exact date and meeting type are not stated.
headline: Board Approves Pay Raise for School Resource Officers to Boost Retention and Morale
summary: The board approved a pay increase for School Resource Officers, to be funded from the district's general fund. The paper reported the decision was unanimous and printed no dollar amount for the raise.

votes.item: Pay increase for School Resource Officers

otherActions: Board member Stacy Stepp told the paper the board compared SRO pay with neighboring school districts and city and county law enforcement before the decision.
The raise is funded from the district's general fund and was reported as already in effect.

quote.text: To have quality officers, you have to meet that financial demand.
quote.speaker: Stacy Stepp, board member
